model_annotation: This plot illustrates the F1 score over a range of values, comparing three different training methods. The x-axis, labeled “调标率” (Adjustment Rate), is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.585, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled “F1”, is a linear scale ranging from 52.5 to 72.5, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 2.5. A solid red line represents the Teacher method, beginning at a value of approximately 55.2 and decreasing to approximately 52.8. A blue line represents the Self-Training method, starting at approximately 61.8 and decreasing to approximately 53.3. A green line represents the PST method, beginning at approximately 67.3 and decreasing to approximately 62.1.
